summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel
details:
The SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP5 kernel was updated to fix various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-46165: openvswitch: vport: fix self-deadlock on release of tunnel ports (bsc#1266836).
- CVE-2026-31678: openvswitch: defer tunnel netdev_put to RCU release (bsc#1263562).
- CVE-2026-31708: smb: client: fix OOB read in smb2_ioctl_query_info QUERY_INFO path (bsc#1264022).
- CVE-2026-31709: smb: client: validate the whole DACL before rewriting it in cifsacl (bsc#1264024).
- CVE-2026-43350: smb: client: require a full NFS mode SID before reading mode bits (bsc#1264985).
- CVE-2026-46135: nvmet-tcp: fix race between ICReq handling and queue teardown (bsc#1267373).
- CVE-2026-64320: nvmet: fix pre-auth out-of-bounds heap read in Discovery Get Log Page (bsc#1273420).
- CVE-2026-72318: cifs: validate DFS referral string offsets (bsc#1275939).
- CVE-2026-74334: RDMA/nldev: Fix locking when accessing mr->pd (bsc#1277095).
- CVE-2026-74565: netfilter: nf_tables: make nft_object rhltable per table (bsc#1275568).
- CVE-2026-74580: vhost: reset the vring metadata cache on vring reconfiguration (bsc#1277885).
- CVE-2026-74746: netfilter: flowtable: publish GC-visible tuple last (bsc#1278101).
- CVE-2026-80558: libceph: Avoid using invalid osd indices from primary_temp (bsc#1277485).
- CVE-2026-80561: libceph: fix multiple unsafe decodes in decode_locker() (bsc#1277265).
- CVE-2026-89606: ecryptfs: reject too-small tag 70 packets (bsc#1280469).
- CVE-2026-89607: ecryptfs: reject oversized encrypted_key_size in parse_tag_3_packet (bsc#1281792).
- CVE-2026-89633: smb: client: fix OOB read/write from unvalidated DataOffset in coalesce_t2() (bsc#1280867).
- CVE-2026-89637: smb: client: fix UAF and buffer leak in cifs_check_trans2() for malformed secondary T2 (bsc#1280492).
- CVE-2026-89650: ceph: bound num_export_targets array for mds info v2/v3 (bsc#1280417).
- CVE-2026-90103: NFSv4.2: fix LAYOUTSTATS send buffer exhaustion (bsc#1281538).
- CVE-2026-90148: NFSv4: Fix incorrect argument passed to nfs4_delete_lease() in nfs4_add_lease() (bsc#1281551).
- CVE-2026-90227: nvme: fine-granular CAP_SYS_ADMIN for nvme io commands (bsc#1281705).
- CVE-2026-90393: bpf: Fix potential UAF in bpf_netns_link_update_prog (bsc#1282289).
- CVE-2026-92507: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in ib_dealloc_pd_user() (bsc#1281988).
- CVE-2026-92508: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in ib_free_cq() (bsc#1282034).
- CVE-2026-92509: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in counter_release() (bsc#1282040).
- CVE-2026-92510: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in ib_destroy_srq_user() (bsc#1282041).
- CVE-2026-92511: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in ib_destroy_cq_user() (bsc#1282042).
- CVE-2026-92512: RDMA/core: Fix use after free in ib_query_qp() (bsc#1281995).
- CVE-2026-93054: uio: Fix stale info pointer in failed registration path (bsc#1282276).
- CVE-2026-93262: md/raid5-ppl: fix use-after-free in ppl_do_flush() (bsc#1283004).
- CVE-2026-93817: perf: Fix addr_filter_ranges lifetime (bsc#1283017).
- CVE-2026-97596: ipvs: reject invalid states in connection template sync records (bsc#1283941).
- CVE-2026-97612: net: mpls: clear inner_protocol when the last label is popped (bsc#1283967).
- CVE-2026-98258: posix-cpu-timers: Prevent freeing a timer which is queued on the expiry list (bsc#1284584).
- CVE-2026-98264: ALSA: virtio: reset device before deleting virtqueues (bsc#1284363).
- CVE-2026-98282: powerpc/iommu: Fix the overflow validation in iommu_tce_check_ioba (bsc#1284360).
- CVE-2026-98306: seg6: set IPSKB_L3SLAVE from IP6SKB_L3SLAVE on IPIP decapsulation (bsc#1284505).
- CVE-2026-98374: tcp: fix use-after-free of retransmit_skb_hint in tcp_send_synack() (bsc#1284740).
- CVE-2026-98863: KVM: x86: Re-pend GET_NESTED_STATE_PAGES if getting said pages fails (bsc#1286257).

The following non security issues were fixed:

- mana: simulate enable_work/disable_work API for queue_reset_work (bsc#1285914).
- nvmet-tcp: do not continue for invalid icreq (git-fixes).
- RDMA/core: Add rdma_restrack_begin/abort/commit_del() operations (git-fixes).
- Revert 'mkspec: Exclude rt flavor from kernel-syms dependencies' (bsc#1244337).
- Revert 'rpm/mkspec: Fix missing kernel-syms-rt creation' (bsc#1244337).
